description.value: The Crane and Robin is a seasonal dine-in restaurant tucked into Montague Harbour Marina on Galiano Island, serving sustainably caught BC seafood, pasture-raised meats from Berryman Farms on the Saanich Peninsula, and a menu heavily weighted toward vegan and gluten-free options. It draws a mix of boaters, hikers, and cyclists visiting the Gulf Islands, operating on a strictly first-come, first-served basis with no reservations. The setting at the marina means cyclists arriving via the Galiano ferry land in easy riding distance.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the business is open and operating seasonally from May 1st 2026, located at Montague Harbour Marina on Galiano Island — not Chemainus as the OSM community tag suggests. Phone (250 539 3334) and email (craneandrobin@gmail.com) on the website match OSM exactly; the /contact page confirms the 3451 Montague Road address. Vegan and GF options are explicitly confirmed in the FAQ and reflected throughout the menu; takeout is conditionally available per FAQ.
concerns: OSM community tag says 'Chemainus' but the restaurant is located at Montague Harbour Marina on Galiano Island — a separate Gulf Island with its own ferry service. The community tag appears to be incorrect.
Website FAQ notes 6 steps between the restaurant and the parking lot ramp, so the venue is not wheelchair accessible.
Seasonal operation only (roughly May–September per OSM opening_hours); not a year-round destination.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating seasonal restaurant confirmed open from May 1st 2026 with active website, menu, and contact details. Clearly a useful stop for touring cyclists on Galiano Island.

Takeout.detail: FAQ states takeout is case-by-case: not reliably available in high season due to dine-in demand, but possible in shoulder seasons or slower days

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: FAQ explicitly confirms: 'All of our vegetarian items are vegan, only the sandwiches contain gluten.' Menu marks V and GF items throughout including salads, tacos, soups, and sandwiches

wow_evidence: tucked into Montague Harbour Marina on Galiano Island, serving sustainably caught BC seafood

price.label: Casual
price.signal: Mains $20–25: tacos, salads, sandwiches; casual first-come-first-served
